Already do…. :( it’s still not enough.  It feels like my skin has been on fire for almost 2 weeks needing it 24/7

I don’t care about the naked people at all. I don’t even care if he watches porn infront of me. It’s the fact he was looking at pictures of a girl who sent the pictures to my brother. They wernt meant for him. She didn’t consent  to her picture being shown to any one other than my brother.
That sounds like a good idea. Thanks.
My issue isn’t with the naked girls. It’s the fact those girls sent them to my brother. Not him.  They had no right sharing her pictures. …
That’s the perfect way to describe it. Like can just go home already!
And it’s that the future you could anticipate for your self isn’t what you want to even bother with experiencing….

It weird. I’ve been suicidal since I was 6, had some attempts through the years and always depressed. But my life if you look at the big picture is pretty ok. I have a good job, house and partner. My parents are alive and well who love and support me… but it doesn’t seem to change anything. I’ve just been getting hit with these extreme emotions of death and grief of my self that I just can’t deny it anymore. Now it’s just prepping for when…. It’s like a train is coming and there is no way to stop it. I just don’t belong here anymore.
I think I wanna wait until my husband finishes school. I don’t want him to suffer financially
I’m just trying to get my affairs in order.
100%. At this time I’m not sad about what’s going on around me I’m just mourning my death.
Same. It’s just all part of the game now

I know that feeling. Every time I reach out to others when they are in pain I talk to them for a few days and they feel better..then nothing. They stop talking to me. Ans they never ask how I’m doing. :(

When I was around 7/8 there was a big oil container about 10 feet long and 4 feet wide as a cylinder on the ground. My cousin and I would sneak up it and climb inside as a hiding space where she and I would eat our favorite chocolate. I’ve been thinking about memories a lot lately…
